title: SR-1.36 Discover supported clients and connect selected clients
request: The owner requested discovery of every supported client and connection of selected clients. Repository: memev; baseline 043854de5fce639531294a4b569f239baab235eb. Companion: SR-1.37 in memev-app. Only the owner signs. All implementation requires a signed contract first. Existing coordination and merge gates remain unchanged. Product ids and literal platform paths are technical identifiers, not authorship. Unverified integration claims require SR-1.37 T5 laptop evidence; unsupported automation remains a manual step. Each changed criterion must demonstrably fail at the recorded base and pass at the proposed head; record both executions. No operational credential files may be read.

tasks.title: Discovery finds every supported client on Windows, macOS and Linux
requirements: src/cli/discover.mjs exports discover(env, platform, readers) whose registry, directory and PATH readers are injectable, and memev discover --json prints one object per app with id, name, found, evidence, install_path, automation (auto, one-step or none) and step

on Windows it reads DisplayName, DisplayVersion, InstallLocation and DisplayIcon only, from HKCU, HKLM and HKLM WOW6432Node Uninstall, with one absolute system reg.exe query per hive, shell:false and a timeout; when InstallLocation is blank it falls back to the folder of DisplayIcon, then to the app's known folders

it also matches MSIX package family names by listing %LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages folder names, folders under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs, Program Files and AppData, /Applications and ~/Applications on macOS, .desktop files on Linux, files on PATH, and the config folders each app already had
every id in clientDefs and unsupportedDefs has a probe, and an app the old folder check found is still found (no regression)
discovery never runs a found binary and never opens a file inside an app's data folder; it reads names, registry values and directory listings only

Spy on spawn, spawnSync, execFile, execFileSync, fork and exec and readFile, readFileSync, fs.promises.readFile, open, openSync, fs.promises.open, createReadStream and readSync, including imported aliases. Resolve realpath and symlink boundaries before access; reject links escaping permitted discovery roots or targeting client data contents. Metadata-only directory listing is permitted; realpath resolution never grants content access.

The sole process exception is an absolute system reg.exe query on Windows with shell:false, once per configured hive, bounded by timeout; no PATH lookup, shell command or additional process is allowed.
